en.headline: Digital Policy Office orders departments to check systems after cyber incidents
en.dek: The office said it has instructed bureaus to prioritise reviews of systems holding personal data and strengthen incident reporting amid a rise in AI-assisted attacks.
body: The Digital Policy Office said on Saturday it is highly concerned about recent cybersecurity incidents and has ordered all government bureaus and departments to prioritise checks on key systems that handle personal and sensitive data.

The office cited an increasing trend of cyberattacks that use artificial intelligence to scan for vulnerabilities. It said departments and their contractors must fulfil their cybersecurity responsibilities and ensure defensive measures are in place.

Incident reporting mechanisms have been strengthened so that any security anomaly or breach is reported to the office immediately for central coordination and rapid response. The office said it would provide full support and work closely with departments and contractors.

The measures follow a series of unauthorised access incidents reported by public and private organisations in recent weeks. The office said the steps aim to reinforce the defence of government systems and public data.

zh.headline: 數字辦指示各部門優先檢查涉及個人資料系統
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室表示高度關注近期網絡安全事故，已指示各部門優先檢查涉個人及敏感資料的重要系統，並強化事故通報機制。
body: 數字政策辦公室周六表示高度關注近期網絡安全及資料外泄事故，並已指示各政府部門優先檢查涉及個人及敏感資料的重要系統。
數字辦指，針對近期出現利用人工智能攻擊網上系統的趨勢，已採取一系列加強措施。各部門與其承辦商須切實履行網絡安全責任，確保防禦措施到位。
數字辦同時強化事故通報機制，要求部門一旦發現保安異常或資料外泄，必須第一時間向數字辦報告，以便即時作出應對。數字辦表示會全力提供支援，與各部門及承辦商緊密協作。
有關措施是在多間公私營機構接連通報未經授權存取事故後提出。數字辦表示，有關步驟旨在全方位守護政府系統與數據安全。
